name: Hotel De La Ville
positioning: Rocco Forte hotel in an 18th-century palazzo on Via Sistina above the Spanish Steps, with a top-floor restaurant and a subterranean spa
best_for: Travelers who want a base a short walk from the Spanish Steps and the centro storico
Families using the Rocco Forte Kids programme
Guests interested in cocktails, rooftop dining and spa time

facts.text: Hotel de la Ville is an 18th-century palazzo above the Spanish Steps.
The hotel's address is Via Sistina 69, Rome.
At Cielo, Chef Fulvio Pierangelini's menu celebrates Mediterranean flavours, from refined seafood to seasonal ingredients.
Mosaico offers dining al fresco in the courtyard or in a dining room with an open kitchen.
Breakfast at Mosaico includes an a la carte menu with dishes such as Carbonara scrambled eggs.
Cafe Ginori is an all-day dining concept run in partnership with the porcelain brand Ginori 1735.
Julep's signature drinks are created by Simone Di Serio, Director of Mixology.
The spa's thermal area has a salt room, sauna, steam, ice fountain, Kneipp foot baths and a hydro pool.
The spa includes a double treatment suite with a private Rasul.
The Rocco Forte Kids programme is tailored for babies, kids and teens.
Babysitting is available around the clock on request, subject to a supplement.
The hotel was previously the InterContinental De La Ville before Rocco Forte's makeover.

highlights.text: Cielo is a restaurant on the top floor of the hotel, overlooking Rome.
Julep Herbal & Vermouth Bar has a cocktail menu inspired by the 13th-century spice route that began in Venice.
Irene Forte Spa is a subterranean spa moments from the Spanish Steps.
Architect Tommaso Ziffer designed the hotel with a Grand Tour theme.
The Canova Suite with Terrace is named for the Neoclassical sculptor Antonio Canova.

considerations.text: Most rooms look onto a quiet inner courtyard or Via Sistina rather than across the rooftops.
Cielo Bar operates first-come, first-served and does not accept reservations.
WhataHotel notes limited parking due to the historic city-centre location.
